name: Mara's Strategic Storage
hypothesis: Previous attempts failed because mandatory deposit rules forced agents to stop at non-full locations (causing zero harvests) or triggered premature resting due to rigid timing. The new policy combines the successful 'always deposit' momentum of child-0024 with an energy-based threshold for gathering, allowing full loads to be carried without stopping unless energy is critically low (<28), which prevents depletion while maximizing trips per 720 steps.
